chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:

Excess of silence produces awe; justice results in more close friends; generosity heightens position; with humility blessings abound in plenty; by facing hardships leadership is achieved; by just behaviour the adversary is overpowered; and with forbearance against a fool there is increase of one’s supporters against him.
ai.seo_question: What are the seven virtues of leadership and character according to Imam Ali in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) presents a comprehensive framework for leadership and personal conduct, emphasizing that silence cultivates dignity (haybah), while fairness and generosity secure loyalty and elevate status. This teaching reflects the Shia understanding of the Imam as the ideal model of governance, where humility and endurance of hardship are not merely personal virtues but essential tools for maintaining authority and overcoming opposition through just conduct.
